composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-00. It receives the whole inputs mapping, distinguishes missing/null/bool/float/wrong-type from exact integer -4..5 inclusive, and always returns {accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null} with a module-level result assignment. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation occurred.

payload.name: pc-transfer-00
payload.description: Raw offset may omit or contain any JSON value. Accept exact integers -4..5 inclusive (not bool/float). Always result={accepted:boolean, offset:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. Unapproved target typed-inputs draft; selected-runner support, Q1 and human Q2 required.
